sources.excerpt: TC Electronic FANGS METAL DISTORTION | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Distortion / TC Electronic FANGS METAL DISTORTION FANGS METAL DISTORTION The TC Electronic FANGS METAL DISTORTION is a high-gain distortion pedal designed for metal and heavy rock guitarists. It offers ultra-thick distortion tones, a versatile mid control, and a super-tight response, making it ideal for both rhythm and lead playing. With its three distinct modes, including Raw, Fat, and Scoop settings, guitarists can dial in a variety of metal tones from classic thrash to modern scooped sounds. The Fangs Metal Distortion features true bypass, top-mounted jacks for pedalboard convenience, and a rugged enclosure, making it a road-ready choice for metal enthusiasts. The pedal delivers all the gain needed, and is an affordable choice for guitarists. What TC Electronic say about the FANGS METAL DISTORTION Ultra-Thick, High Gain Distortion with Super Tight Response www.tcelectronic.com What guitarists say... Guitarists found the TC Electronic Fangs Metal Distortion to be an amazing sounding pedal, especially for the price, delivering the metal tones they were looking for. Reviewers highlighted its great distortion capabilities and ease of use. Users also found it to have a sweet spot, with the ability to create a variety of tones suitable for metal music.
